Ownership is not established by the source (may be individual's ABN), so confidence is kept below the prior 0.9 and flagged. Not a buyer or agency identifier. Rows with failing checksums should be rejected, not coerced.

Held-out values are 9-digit ACN strings with spaces (e.g. '105 317 682'); acn transform validates checksum. Sparse (36 of 3000 non-empty), so coverage is poor; retained at threshold only with checksum validation. Not derived from ABN.

Single-line free-text address labelled as business address; maps to full address only. Locality, state and postcode are embedded and not split, to avoid unreliable parsing. Address may be residential or c/- mailing address.

Licensee Business Address may be residential or c/- mailing address and is not parsed into locality, state, or postcode.
Rows are per licence, so the same licensee yields duplicate observations unless deduplicated downstream.
Resource modification time is a publication proxy; observed_at is left null rather than inferred from it.
The 'abn' and 'acn' transforms are assumed to validate checksums and reject invalid values; this behaviour is unverified because the run failed.
